demo.title: vibe-hub.sh
demo.code:
# Wallet overview with a ready check-in tx
curl -s 'https://vibehome.dog/api/status?address=0xYOUR_WALLET'

# Reward rounds with ready claim txs
curl -s 'https://vibehome.dog/api/claims?address=0xYOUR_WALLET'

# In Bankr chat
bankr "do my vibe hub check-in"
bankr "claim my vibe rewards"

setup: Base mainnet only. API: https://vibehome.dog/api/agent (public, GET, no auth)
The API returns ready txs {to, data, value, sender}; Bankr submits them on Base (8453)
Check-in, achievements, reward claims, staking, swaps and transfers; minting is not done by agents
Requires ETH for gas on Base in the Bankr wallet
